original_question: Shawnda fa adwen sɛ ne mpɔtam nkwadaa no betumi de dadepɔnkɔ a wɔde yɛ adwuma. Ɔfa adwen sɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ sɛ ɔtua no yɛ tae. Tae emu baako biara ka yɛ 25 cents sɛ ebɛ dɔɔso. Da a edi kan no, nnipa 5 a wɔte dadepɔnkɔ so baa sɛ wɔbenya tae mmienu a ɛdɔɔso. Nnipa 3 baa yɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ dadepɔnkɔ tae a ɛwɔsoro yie. ɛtwa toɔ no, onipa baako a ɔde dadepɔnkɔ  baako baa. Dollars dodoɔ ahe na onyaa saa da no?
